name: dsh-dialog-fence
description: A dialogue fence stored in one JSON file: a shared rule list that applies to every conversation plus an optional per-session list, injected into the runtime-context snapshot (cache-safe, append-only, compression-durable). The file location is customizable and can be opened from the UI, and every open attempt reports its outcome instead of failing silently. Installs as a normal DSH bundle, so it shows up under Plugins -> Installed and can be installed/removed with the official installer; its rules are edited on the Settings page, in its own bundle page, and in the conversation panel.
